translations.web: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
translations.bsb: Then the devil led Him up to a high place and showed Him in an instant all the kingdoms of the world.
translations.kjv: And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, shewed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
translations.asv: And he led him up, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.
